    Kernel duality on epimorphic right-Freyd presentations #

    For an epimorphism g : B ⟶ C in an abelian category, its kernel inclusion ker(g) ⟶ B becomes an epimorphism in the opposite category. A square of epimorphisms induces a square of the opposite kernel inclusions in the reverse direction. Right homotopies are carried to right homotopies, so the construction descends to right Freyd categories.
